description: Source code for managing and inspecting file descriptors in a process, including functions to count open FDs, iterate over them, check limits, and print details about each FD.

methods.name: xr_fdc_fd_qty_get
methods.description: Returns the number of open file descriptors for the process.

methods.name: xr_fdc_fd_iterate
methods.description: Iterates over open file descriptors, optionally printing details.

methods.name: xr_fdc_check
methods.description: Checks if the number of open FDs exceeds soft or hard limits and optionally prints details.

methods.name: xr_fdc_print
methods.description: Prints header or details of a specific file descriptor.

methods.name: xr_fdc_flags_str
methods.description: Converts file descriptor flags to a string representation.

methods.name: xr_fdc_mode_str
methods.description: Converts file mode to a string representation.
